title: Neptune: The Long Orbit to Benchmarking Long Video Understanding

live_model.evidence: Section 5.2: 'For GPT-4o we use the public API4'; footnote 4: 'Version gpt-4o-2024-05-13'. Table 4 row 'GPT-4o RGB (8 frames) + ASR 80.23'.

prompt.location: Appendix C.5.6 'GPT-4o prompts' (open-ended and multiple-choice, with/without transcript)

claim.location: Table 4, row GPT-4o (RGB 8 frames + ASR), NEPTUNE-FULL Acc. %

data.source: https://github.com/google-deepmind/neptune (annotations for 2,405 YouTube videos; frames at 1 fps and ASR must be re-extracted)

notes: Videos are YouTube-hosted (availability drift); exact 8-frame sampling and image resolution not specified. Cost is driven by 8 images plus transcript per call.

resolution.plan: The C.5.6 multiple-choice-with-transcript prompt is printed with {video_frames}, {transcript}, {question}, {choices}; the paper states '8 frames + ASR' for GPT-4o but not the sampling rule (the other 8-frame baselines use uniform sampling). Download the NEPTUNE-FULL videos listed in the release (github.com/google-deepmind/neptune; 3,268 MCQs on 2,405 YouTube videos), take 8 uniformly spaced frames, use the released transcript if included or Whisper otherwise, call gpt-4o-2024-05-13, parse '[CHOICE]' and compute accuracy; compare with 80.23 (Table 4) on the videos still available.
resolution.approximation: Uniform 8-frame sampling and default image detail assumed; ASR engine may differ; removed YouTube videos shrink the set (report coverage).
